title: Embrace Adaptability and Resiliency
coreMove: Use the PMBOK principle as a decision test: when evidence shifts, adjust approach, protect recovery capacity, and keep value steadier than the original baseline.

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers facing a slipping public demo
exampleSpecs.stakes: protect value while schedule pressure rises
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: expect resistance to a changed baseline, then reveal feedback that protects higher value

exampleSpecs.audience: facilitators turning principle language into action
exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid reciting principle titles without changing a decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: compressed messages make the lesson land between the lines

exampleSpecs.audience: operations coordinators updating a workback plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: restart the routine when new feedback changes the work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a routine is interrupted and restarted with a better trigger

exampleSpecs.stakes: preserve slack for disruption rather than casual convenience
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: one close observed desk detail carries the lesson

exampleSpecs.audience: release managers tracing a failure after rollback
exampleSpecs.stakes: locate the misstep that made recovery weaker
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open after failure and find the decisive misstep

exampleSpecs.audience: technical leads correcting their own pressure response
exampleSpecs.stakes: notice endurance language before it harms recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist catches his own error mid-stream
